(#{row.runKey}, #{row.pk}, #{row.sk}, #{row.version}, #{row.status}, #{row.balance}, #{row.memoState}, #{row.memo}, #{row.ordinal})
mapper.insert: ON CONFLICT (run_key, pk, sk) DO UPDATE SET delivered = dynamo_work.delivered WHERE (dynamo_work.version, dynamo_work.status, dynamo_work.balance, dynamo_work.memo_state, dynamo_work.memo) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (excluded.version, excluded.status, excluded.balance, excluded.memo_state, excluded.memo)
mapper.update: UPDATE dynamo_run SET next_page = #{nextPage}, state = CASE WHEN #{last} THEN 'READY' ELSE 'PREPARING' END WHERE run_key = #{runKey} AND state = 'PREPARING'
UPDATE dynamo_run SET input_rows = #{rows}, input_sha256 = #{sha256} WHERE run_key = #{runKey} AND state = 'PREPARING'
UPDATE dynamo_run SET state = 'READY' WHERE run_key = #{runKey} AND state = 'PREPARING'
UPDATE dynamo_run SET state = 'APPLIED' WHERE run_key = #{runKey} AND state = 'READY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dynamo_work WHERE run_key = #{runKey} AND NOT delivered)

mapper.select: SELECT candidate.run_key, candidate.pk, candidate.sk, candidate.version, candidate.status, 0::numeric AS balance, 'ABSENT' AS memo_state, NULL::text AS memo, NULL::bigint AS ordinal FROM dynamo_outbox candidate WHERE candidate.run_key = #{runKey} AND NOT candidate.delivered AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dynamo_outbox earlier WHERE earlier.pk = candidate.pk AND earlier.sk = candidate.sk AND earlier.version < candidate.version AND NOT earlier.delivered ) ORDER BY candidate.pk, candidate.sk, candidate.version LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM dynamo_outbox WHERE run_key = #{runKey} AND NOT delivered
mapper.update:
UPDATE dynamo_outbox SET delivered = true WHERE run_key = #{runKey} AND NOT delivered AND (pk, sk, version) IN
(#{row.pk}, #{row.sk}, #{row.version})
mapper.select: WITH desired AS ( SELECT sk::bigint AS id, coalesce(memo, 'Customer ' || sk) AS name, status FROM dynamo_work WHERE run_key = #{runKey} ), changes AS ( SELECT d.*, c.version AS old_version, c.name AS old_name, c.status AS old_status FROM desired d LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = d.id WHERE c.id IS NULL OR (c.name, c.status) IS DISTINCT FROM (d.name, d.status) ), changed AS ( UPDATE customer c SET name = d.name, status = d.status, version = c.version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() FROM changes d WHERE c.id = d.id AND c.version = d.old_version AND (c.name, c.status) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (d.old_name, d.old_status) RETURNING c.id ), added AS ( INSERT INTO customer(id, name, status) SELECT id, name, status FROM changes WHERE old_version IS NULL ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM changes) AS expected, (SELECT count(*) FROM changed) + (SELECT count(*) FROM added) AS updated
